colorMapping.text: For dual-polarization browse, red and blue use co-polarized HH or VV; green uses cross-polarized HV or VH. Dark covered pixels have low displayed returns. Transparent pixels are not imaged. Colors are not temperature, natural color or a calculated HH/HV ratio.

limits: 1024 by 512 global browse overview, about 39 km per pixel at the equator; not full-resolution science.
Lossless WebP encoding preserves the returned browse colors and transparency.
